item.title: github: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Gemini 4 Neon is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for agentic coding, multistep tool use, and knowledge work.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Gemini 3.8 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports Gemini 3.8 Flash, Google’s latest Flash model. GitHub says early testing showed strong performance on complex terminal-based coding tasks.

  • Source: GitHub
